name: InstructionDiagnostic_v1
provenance: Locally authored deterministic synthetic templates; no external dataset. No model responses used during construction.
split_rule: Distinct subject words and names across train/heldout; shared task templates. Measures template/compositional transfer, not broad instruction generalization.
optimizer: Fresh AdamW moments; lr0.0003 betas0.9/0.95 eps1e-8 decay0.1 matrices/0norm; clipping1; FP32; no accumulation
supervision: Response tokens and EOS only; prompt, BOS and padding ignored. Reject sequences exceeding128; no truncation.
decoding: Greedy argmax; max32 new tokens; EOS2; BOS1; rolling context128; no stop strings

rubric.correctness: Exact match after NFC and outer whitespace stripping, case/punctuation preserved; report per task and overall.
rubric.instruction_format: Nonempty single line; repeat exactly3 whitespace words; yes_no exactlyyes/no; other tasks a single alphabetic word. This is format compliance, not semantic correctness.
rubric.coherence: Qualitative evaluator review:2 clear task-appropriate expression;1 readable but irrelevant/fragmented;0 unintelligible. Identify evaluator; not an independent human study. Report separately from exact correctness; retain all responses.
rubric.repetition: Report repeated4gram fraction for responses with>=4tokens, and longest identical whitespace-word run. Short outputs have no repeated4grams.

limits: Small synthetic diagnostic; one seed; shared templates across splits. Not a general conversation, reasoning, factuality or safety benchmark.
